repairs: Task 1: the three radio speech buttons, their three script steps, RAW_SPEECH_GAIN and the n_sts id in the check are gone (script keeps one radio tone at 3 s); the via-radio filter stays.

Fade-in of 3 ms for a voice whose first sample is above 0.002, fade-out of 5 ms before the end of a one-shot whose last sample is above 0.002 (untouched attack where the file starts on silence); both capped at half the buffer; squelch one-shots and the radio hiss are treated alike.

Chained passes: an exact butt joint for passes of one periodic file (no fade either side, start planned from the decoded length), a linear crossfade over the overlap for chained sounds that overlap by about CHAIN_OVERLAP, long designed overlaps untouched.

Start lead raised from 5 ms to 30 ms: currentTime is stale by one audio callback, and a start plus fade-in scheduled in the past was applied at once, which made loud loop starts (cruise_loop) click in the full run although not in isolation.
setGain of a voice never schedules inside its fade-in ramp (a target curve inside a ramp makes the gain jump).

Task 3: limiter = DynamicsCompressor (-2 dB, knee 0, ratio 20, attack 1 ms, release 0.1 s) followed by a gain that cancels its make-up gain, measured at start-up in an OfflineAudioContext (measured 1.14 dB). A -20 dBFS sine passes with -0.000 dB; a +6 dBFS sine leaves at -1.42 dBFS after 20 ms. Header comment of engine.ts updated. Latched OVER lamp (#over-lamp) next to the meter, lit at 0.999 after the limiter, stays until clicked, German and English titles.
Wiring is changed only when the limiter is switched, not on every slider move.
task4: Check confirms the first category on the page is cat-pilot, titled Richtungsproben (Runde 3); it skips when the manifest has no pilot category. It ran against the real manifest (pilot present, 11 sounds) and passed.
